q.en: Do I have to hug or kiss relatives when I don't want to?
q.hg: Kya mann na ho tab bhi relatives ko hug ya pappi dena zaroori hai?

a.en: No. Your body belongs to you, so you get to choose. You can say 'No, thank you' and do a namaste, a wave or a high-five instead. That is still good manners. If a grown-up keeps forcing you, tell mummy, papa or another grown-up you trust.
a.hg: Nahi. Tumhari body tumhari hai, isliye choice tumhari hai. Tum 'Nahi, thank you' bolkar namaste kar sakte ho, wave kar sakte ho ya high-five de sakte ho. Yeh bhi acchi manners hai. Agar koi bada baar-baar zabardasti kare, toh mummy, papa ya kisi aur trusted bade ko batao.

q.en: Someone told me to keep a secret and it makes me feel scared. What should I do?
q.hg: Kisi ne mujhse ek secret rakhne ko bola hai aur mujhe usse darr lagta hai. Main kya karoon?

a.en: Tell a grown-up you trust, today. A secret that makes you scared or sad is an unsafe secret. You do not have to keep it, even if you promised. You will not be in trouble for telling. If the first grown-up does not listen, tell another one. You can also call 1098.
a.hg: Aaj hi kisi trusted bade ko bata do. Jo secret tumhe daraye ya udaas kare, woh unsafe secret hai. Usse rakhna zaroori nahi, chahe tumne promise kiya ho. Batane par tumhe daant nahi padegi. Agar pehla bada na sune, toh kisi aur ko batao. Tum 1098 par call bhi kar sakte ho.

q.en: My friend keeps tickling and grabbing me even after I say stop. How do I make them stop?
q.hg: Mera dost 'stop' bolne ke baad bhi mujhe gudgudi karta aur pakadta rehta hai. Usse kaise rokoon?

a.en: Say it once more, seriously and without smiling: 'Stop. I don't like this. Don't do it again.' Then move away. Friends sometimes think it is a joke because you laughed, but tickling makes people laugh even when they hate it. If they carry on after a clear stop, it is no longer play. It is ignoring your boundary. Tell a teacher or a parent. Asking an adult for help is not tattling; it is what you do when your no is not being heard.
a.hg: Ek baar aur bolo, seriously aur bina smile kiye: 'Ruko. Mujhe yeh pasand nahi. Dobara mat karna.' Phir wahan se hat jao. Kabhi-kabhi dost isse mazaak samajhte hain kyunki tum has rahe the, par gudgudi mein insaan tab bhi hasta hai jab usse bilkul accha na lag raha ho. Agar clear 'stop' ke baad bhi woh na ruke, toh yeh khel nahi raha. Yeh tumhari boundary ko ignore karna hai. Teacher ya parents ko batao. Adult se help maangna chugli nahi hai; jab tumhari 'no' na suni jaaye, tab yahi karna chahiye.

q.en: An older person gives me gifts and says not to tell my parents. Is that okay?
q.hg: Ek bada insaan mujhe gifts deta hai aur bolta hai mummy-papa ko mat batana. Kya yeh theek hai?

a.en: No, it is a warning sign. Safe adults do not ask children to hide gifts, chats or meetings from their parents. Some people use gifts, attention and secrets to build trust slowly, so that a child later feels unable to refuse or to tell. This is called grooming. You have done nothing wrong by accepting a gift. Tell a parent or another trusted adult now, even if the person is someone your family knows well, and do not meet them alone. You can also call the Child Helpline on 1098.
a.hg: Nahi, yeh warning sign hai. Safe adults bachchon se gifts, chats ya milna-julna parents se chhupane ko nahi bolte. Kuch log gifts, attention aur secrets ke sahare dheere-dheere trust banate hain, taaki baad mein bachcha na mana kar paaye aur na kisi ko bata paaye. Isse grooming kehte hain. Gift lekar tumne kuch galat nahi kiya. Abhi parents ya kisi aur trusted adult ko batao, chahe woh insaan tumhari family ka accha jaankaar hi kyun na ho, aur usse akele mat milo. Tum Child Helpline 1098 par bhi call kar sakte ho.

q.en: If someone didn't say no, doesn't that mean it was okay?
q.hg: Agar kisi ne 'no' nahi bola, toh kya iska matlab yeh nahi ki sab okay tha?

a.en: No. Consent is the presence of a clear yes, not the absence of a no. People stay silent for many reasons: fear, shock, embarrassment, not wanting to upset someone, or freezing so completely that words will not come out. If you are not sure the other person is willing, ask. If you do not get a clear, comfortable yes, stop. And if you were the one who stayed silent while something unwanted happened, your silence did not make it your fault. A trusted adult or 1098 can help you talk it through.
a.hg: Nahi. Consent ka matlab clear 'yes' ka hona hai, 'no' ka na hona nahi. Log kai wajah se chup reh jaate hain: darr, shock, sharam, kisi ko upset na karne ki chah, ya itna freeze ho jaana ki muh se words hi na niklein. Agar tumhe pakka nahi ki saamne wala raazi hai, toh poocho. Agar clear aur comfortable 'yes' na mile, toh ruk jao. Aur agar chup tum rahe the, jab tumhare saath kuch unwanted hua, toh tumhari chuppi se woh tumhari galti nahi ban jaati. Koi trusted adult ya 1098 is par baat karne mein tumhari help kar sakta hai.

q.en: My boyfriend/girlfriend says 'if you loved me, you would'. Is that pressure?
q.hg: Mera boyfriend/girlfriend bolta hai, 'pyaar karte toh maan jaate'. Kya yeh pressure hai?

a.en: Yes. That line turns your no into 'proof' that you do not care, which is emotional pressure, not love. Someone who cares about you can hear no without punishing you with guilt, sulking or threats to leave. You never have to prove love with your body or with photos. Also remember that under the POCSO Act a person under 18 cannot legally consent to sexual activity, and waiting is a completely valid choice. You can say: 'I care about you, and my answer is still no.' If the pressure continues or becomes threats, talk to a trusted adult or call 1098.
a.hg: Haan. Yeh line tumhari 'no' ko is baat ka 'proof' bana deti hai ki tumhe parwah nahi, aur yeh emotional pressure hai, pyaar nahi. Jise tumhari parwah hai, woh 'no' sun sakta hai, bina guilt diye, muh phulaye ya chhod dene ki dhamki diye. Pyaar prove karne ke liye tumhe kabhi apni body ya photos dene ki zaroorat nahi. Yeh bhi yaad rakho ki POCSO Act ke under 18 se kam umar ka person sexual activity ke liye legally consent nahi de sakta, aur wait karna poori tarah valid choice hai. Tum bol sakte ho: 'Mujhe tumhari parwah hai, aur mera jawab ab bhi no hai.' Agar pressure chalta rahe ya dhamki ban jaaye, toh kisi trusted adult se baat karo ya 1098 par call karo.

q.en: We are both under 18 and we both want to. Is it still against the law?
q.hg: Hum dono 18 se kam hain aur dono raazi hain. Kya yeh tab bhi law ke against hai?

a.en: Yes. Under the POCSO Act, any sexual act with a person under 18 is an offence; a minor's agreement is not legal consent, even when both are under 18 and close in age. An accused under 18 goes through the juvenile justice system. Doctors, teachers and counsellors who come to know must report it, but do not let that stop you getting medical care; you can ask first what they must report. If you feel pushed, or the other person is older, tell a trusted adult or call 1098. Your feelings are normal, and waiting is a valid choice. Laws can change; this is not legal advice.
a.hg: Haan. POCSO Act ke under 18 se kam umar ke kisi bhi person ke saath koi bhi sexual act offence hai; minor ka agreement legal consent nahi hai, chahe dono 18 se kam hon aur age mein close hon. 18 se kam umar ke accused ka case juvenile justice system ke through chalta hai. Jin doctors, teachers aur counsellors ko pata chalta hai, unhe isse report karna hota hai, lekin is wajah se medical care lena mat chhodo; tum pehle hi pooch sakte ho ki unhe kya report karna zaroori hai. Agar tum par pressure hai, ya doosra insaan tumse bada hai, toh kisi trusted adult ko batao ya 1098 par call karo. Tumhari feelings normal hain, aur wait karna ek valid choice hai. Laws badal sakte hain; yeh legal advice nahi hai.

q.en: I sent someone a private photo and now they are threatening to share it. What can I do?
q.hg: Maine kisi ko apni private photo bheji thi aur ab woh usse share karne ki dhamki de raha hai. Main kya kar sakta/sakti hoon?

a.en: You are not the one who did wrong; the threat is the offence. Do not pay, do not send more, and do not bargain. Do not delete the chat or the person's account details, because investigators can use them, but do not forward the image to anyone, even as proof. Tell a trusted adult and report at cybercrime.gov.in or on 1930; if you are under 18 you can also call 1098. The platform can be asked to take the image down. A sexual image of someone under 18 counts as child sexual abuse material, so the person keeping or sharing it is committing a serious offence.
a.hg: Galti tumhari nahi hai; offence dhamki dena hai. Paise mat do, aur photos mat bhejo, aur bargaining mat karo. Chat ya us insaan ke account details delete mat karo, kyunki investigators ke kaam aa sakte hain, lekin woh image kisi ko forward mat karo, proof ke liye bhi nahi. Kisi trusted adult ko batao aur cybercrime.gov.in ya 1930 par report karo; tum 18 se kam ho toh 1098 par bhi call kar sakte ho. Platform se image hatane ko bola ja sakta hai. 18 se kam umar ke insaan ki sexual image child sexual abuse material maani jaati hai, isliye jo insaan usse rakh raha hai ya share kar raha hai, woh serious offence kar raha hai.

q.en: Can a person give consent if they are drunk?
q.hg: Kya drunk insaan consent de sakta hai?

a.en: Not if they are too intoxicated to understand what is happening or to communicate clearly. Warning signs include slurred speech, stumbling, vomiting or drifting off. Being slightly tipsy is not the same as being incapacitated, but the line is hard to judge from outside, and a wrong guess harms the other person. So: if in doubt, don't. Being drunk yourself never excuses ignoring consent. If either person is under 18, the POCSO Act does not recognise their consent at all, drunk or sober. If a friend is in that state, stay with them, get them home safely, and call 112 if they cannot be woken or their breathing seems wrong.
a.hg: Nahi, agar woh itne nashe mein hai ki samajh nahi pa raha ki kya ho raha hai, ya clearly communicate nahi kar pa raha. Warning signs hain slurred speech, ladkhadana, ulti ya neend mein dhulak jaana. Thoda tipsy hona aur hosh kho dena ek cheez nahi hai, lekin bahar se yeh line judge karna mushkil hai, aur galat andaaze ka nuksaan doosre insaan ko bhugatna padta hai. Isliye: doubt ho, toh mat karo. Khud drunk hona consent ignore karne ka excuse kabhi nahi hai. Agar dono mein se koi bhi 18 se kam hai, toh POCSO Act uske consent ko maanta hi nahi, chahe drunk ho ya sober. Agar koi dost aisi haalat mein hai, toh uske saath raho, usse safely ghar pahunchao, aur agar woh jagaane par na uthe ya uski saans theek na lage toh 112 par call karo.

q.en: My husband says a wife cannot refuse sex. Is that true?
q.hg: Mere husband bolte hain ki wife sex ke liye mana nahi kar sakti. Kya yeh sach hai?

a.en: No. Marriage does not remove your right to say no, and forced sex within marriage is sexual violence, ethically and medically. Legally it is more complicated: the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita currently keeps an exception, so intercourse by a husband with a wife who is not under 18 is not classed as 'rape'. That exception is contested and under legal challenge. You still have remedies. The Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 covers sexual abuse and allows protection orders, and physical violence and cruelty by a husband are criminal offences. Call 181, or 112 in danger. This is general information, not legal advice.
a.hg: Nahi. Shaadi 'no' bolne ka tumhara right nahi chheenti, aur shaadi ke andar forced sex ethically aur medically sexual violence hai. Legally baat thodi complicated hai: Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita mein abhi ek exception hai, jiski wajah se husband ka aisi wife ke saath intercourse, jo 18 se kam umar ki nahi hai, 'rape' classify nahi hota. Yeh exception contested hai aur isse court mein challenge kiya gaya hai. Phir bhi tumhare paas remedies hain. Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 sexual abuse ko cover karta hai aur protection orders dila sakta hai, aur husband ki taraf se maar-peet aur cruelty criminal offences hain. 181 par call karo, ya danger mein 112 par. Yeh general information hai, legal advice nahi.

q.en: My friend told me they were sexually assaulted. What do I do now?
q.hg: Mere dost ne bataya ki uske saath sexual assault hua hai. Ab main kya karoon?

a.en: Start by believing them and saying it is not their fault. Then stay practical. Sit with them, let them set the pace, and offer to go along to a trusted adult, a doctor or a helpline call rather than sending them alone. If it happened recently, gently mention that medical care is time-sensitive. If your friend is under 18 or still in danger, do not promise to keep it secret; explain that an adult needs to know so they can be protected, and call 1098 or 112 together. Hearing this is heavy for you too, so talk to a counsellor or Tele-MANAS on 14416.
a.hg: Sabse pehle un par believe karo aur bolo ki isme unki galti nahi hai. Phir practical raho. Unke paas baitho, pace unhe set karne do, aur unhe akele bhejne ki jagah khud saath chalne ka offer do, chahe trusted adult ke paas jaana ho, doctor ke paas, ya helpline par call karna ho. Agar yeh recently hua hai, toh pyaar se batao ki medical care time-sensitive hoti hai. Agar tumhara dost 18 se kam umar ka hai ya ab bhi danger mein hai, toh secret rakhne ka promise mat karo; samjhao ki unki safety ke liye kisi adult ka jaanna zaroori hai, aur saath milkar 1098 ya 112 par call karo. Yeh sab sunna tumhare liye bhi heavy hai, isliye kisi counsellor se ya Tele-MANAS 14416 par baat karo.

q.en: I froze and couldn't say no or fight back. Does that mean I agreed?
q.hg: Main freeze ho gaya/gayi aur na 'no' bol paaya/paayi, na fight back kar paaya/paayi. Kya iska matlab hai ki main raazi tha/thi?

a.en: No. Freezing is an automatic survival response, like fight or flight, and many survivors cannot move or speak. It is not a choice and it is not consent, even if you knew the person, agreed to something else earlier, or told nobody straight away. The responsibility belongs to the person who went ahead without your consent. If it happened in the last few days, see a doctor soon: HIV-prevention medicine must start within 72 hours, and emergency contraception works up to 5 days. If you are unsafe now, call 112, or 1098 if under 18. At your own pace, a trusted adult, 181 or Tele-MANAS 14416 can help.
a.hg: Nahi. Freeze ho jaana fight aur flight ki tarah body ka automatic survival response hai, aur bahut se survivors na hil paate hain, na bol paate hain. Yeh koi choice nahi hai aur yeh consent nahi hai, chahe tum us insaan ko jaante ho, pehle kisi aur cheez ke liye haan bola ho, ya turant kisi ko na bataya ho. Zimmedari us insaan ki hai jo tumhare consent ke bina aage badha. Agar yeh pichhle kuch dinon mein hua hai, toh jaldi doctor ko dikhao: HIV se bachane wali medicine 72 ghante ke andar shuru honi chahiye, aur emergency contraception sirf 5 din tak kaam karti hai. Agar abhi danger hai, toh 112 par, ya 18 se kam ho toh 1098 par call karo. Apni speed se, kisi trusted adult, 181 ya Tele-MANAS 14416 se baat karna help kar sakta hai.
